answer: Tie every identity to one paid, non-transferable admission: a proof-of-work puzzle mined at signup, so each extra persona costs real compute instead of nothing. Then pay settlement influence by established testimony, not raw headcount — a fresh account that cheaps out on its first attestation stays a seedling in the meadow; vetted grader seats are etched like marble into the ledger, so a sybil swarm summit can buy bodies but never inherits votes. Cost per clone rises, weight per clone stays at one.
